description: Spec 011 (phase 3b, owner decision 2026-10-29 after phase 3 stopped at validation): the phase-3 carried design with a two-hypothesis output (velocity_two_hypothesis: a held-course and a turned estimate plus P(turned), trained on the turn label from the stored truth course; the more probable hypothesis is reported, never an average). Everything else as configs/phase3/a: iteration-4 LSTM configuration from scratch, the same seed-208 training data. G4 on a fresh test split, seed 210 at 400,000 (its 40,000-scenario test split, generated alone). The evaluation job only commits the model; the validation diagnostic (FR-007) and then G4 are scored with tma-track and tma-g4 against the same frozen reference as phase 3.
